verdict.rationale: Superhuman offers team-collaboration signals like shared read statuses, reply indicators, and @mention team comments that help avoid duplicate work, plus shared snippets and team scheduling — but there is no evidence of formal conversation assignment or rule-based mail routing that establishes explicit ownership of a thread to a specific teammate. Missing for 10: dedicated 'assign to teammate' functionality, configurable routing/ownership rules for incoming mail, and any independent confirmation these team features work as advertised.
